description: Requires explicit orders:manage permission and the bound supplier. Confirm may capture the original buyer-authorized payment; reject releases that authorization. Cancel may refund the original payment only against an existing buyer cancellation request within its approved fee cap. Submit exact expected_version and stable idempotency_key. On ORDER_VERSION_CONFLICT read and obtain a fresh decision; never automatically rebase a financial action. No new purchase, payment authorization, withdrawal or outreach.
name: evuun_decide_business_order
title: Decide Business Order
